Name: Simple Skills Extented 2
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📖 Simple Skills Extented 2[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC 2.20 • Android experimental 1.5[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]A more balanced version of SSE 1, with reduced yield and combat bonuses. Extend Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat to level 110. Choose from 76 professions and 131 ranks, with up to 23 profession points per skill.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Professions & Points[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Earn 16 points per skill from levels 35–110, one every five levels. Four completed trials add four points, and three profession manuals add three more: 23 points per skill. Each rank costs one point and requires the previous rank. Most professions unlock at level 35; advanced professions unlock at 105. You can learn every profession at rank I, but cannot maximize every rank.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Abilities include Transplant, Scythe Harvest, Crop Insight, Dash, Timed Guard, Orchard Sweep and Coal Prospector. Gentle Hands grants +5 / +10 friendship on each animal’s first successful manual pet of the day. Learned effects can be switched off without losing their ranks or refunding their points.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🏅 Trials & Profession Manuals[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Each skill has four activity trials, unlocked at levels 25, 50, 70 and 100. Complete and claim them in order for a medal and one profession point each. Objectives cover crops and animal products, fishing, forage and trees, mining and metalworking, or combat.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Find three personal manuals per skill through qualifying skill activities. Manuals have no level requirement; each edition grants one point when read. Read an edition before searching for the next. A guaranteed fallback prevents endless bad luck. The Trials & Manuals menu shows eligible activities, drop odds and the action counter. Points earned early are banked until profession spending opens at level 35.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🌱 Automatic Level Rewards[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Farming: crop and animal produce, seed refunds, quality, growth and fertilizer benefits.
Fishing: bite speed, tackle protection, fishing-bar size, perfect-catch bonuses and treasure rewards.
Foraging: wood, tree seeds, eligible ground forage and berry pickup reach.
Mining: ore, coal, stone, gems, geodes and mining benefits.
Combat: health, direct melee bonuses, monster loot and recovery.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]At level 110, eligible crop and animal produce gains up to +40%, matching ground forage has a 50% bonus chance per original item, and genuinely perfect eligible rod catches have up to a 70% chance for one additional fish. Seed refunds reach their 30% maximum at level 110. Profession bonuses are separate.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Berry Reach adds up to 32 pixels of berry pickup distance. Sure Footing reduces monster knockback by up to 10%, combining multiplicatively with Steady Footing. Light Cast reduces native casting energy costs by up to 10%.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]📚 Skills Journal & Profession Choices[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Inspect current bonuses, future levels, professions, trials, manuals and achievements in the Skills Journal. Spend available points through Perks whenever you are ready; another five-level increase is not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use Skip remaining notices / Skip all notices on an SSE reward window to dismiss that night’s remaining notices. Keyboard X and controller Y also work. Unspent points and outstanding profession choices stay available in the journal. To hide optional notices permanently, turn off Show level-up reward windows in settings.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]For outstanding vanilla profession choices earned at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30, open Skills Journal → Perks, select the skill, then choose Claim earned professions. Use the button, P, or controller View/Back. No new level-up or sleep is required. Cancel with Escape, right-click or controller B. A claimed choice cannot be awarded again.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The achievement cabinet includes 80 level milestones, cosmetic titles at 50, 75 and 100, and a level-100 display trophy for each skill.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese follow the game’s selected language.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Installation & Upgrading from SSE 1[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on PC and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2 into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Install only one SSE edition.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Back up your save and config.json before replacing SSE 1. Keep the same save and copy the old config.json into the SSE 2 folder to retain settings. Supported stored XP, levels and earned professions are preserved. New SSE 2 level points are calculated from the preserved level: level 100 gives 14, and level 110 gives 16, before trial/manual rewards. Claim outstanding vanilla choices through the journal. Do not run SSE 1’s removal preparation when upgrading to SSE 2.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🤝 Other Mods[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The five native base skills stay capped at 10. SSE tracks its extended levels and rewards separately up to 110. Temporary food and drink skill buffs still apply.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]SSE takes priority with Level Extender 3.0.0 for the five shared skills and overlapping duplication, crop-growth, fishing and tool-stamina effects. Level Extender’s automatic vanilla-skill progression pauses while its stored records, custom skills and unrelated features remain. Use the SSE journal for SSE progression.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC 2.20 and Android Experimental 1.5 include Farming Level Affects Harvest priority. SSE filters its crop-level yield increase while preserving normal crop yields, native multi-harvest behavior and unrelated crop changes. The filter targets that content-pack family; other yield mods are not globally disabled.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC 2.20 and Android Experimental 1.5 fix the reported “1 cannot be greater than 0” harvest-quality error during direct collection and scythe harvesting.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Checked with the actual Level Extender 3.0.0 DLL and Content Patcher 2.9.1 using official Farming Level Affects Harvest main/Percentage Config 1.2.4 and SVE add-on 1.0.2 field fixtures, including native parsnip, blueberry and rice harvests. These are controlled desktop tests. Full modpack gameplay, full content-pack token loading, additional skill/harvest overhauls and Android third-party mod ports remain unverified.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]SSE keeps its XP, earned levels and rewards independent when using supported skill-overhaul adapters. Integrations cover Mastery Extended, Walk of Life, Vanilla Plus Professions and Apex Mastery. SpaceCore and Simple Skill Bars can display SSE progression; older supported Skill Bars bridges recognize SSE 2 and its level-110 progression. Custom skills keep their own progression.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Compatibility depends on the other mod’s version. Walk of Life and Vanilla Plus Professions remain incompatible with each other; SSE does not resolve that pairing.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🧪 Android Experimental — Optional File[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Android Experimental 1.5 includes the PC 2.20 shared features and priority adapters for Level Extender and Farming Level Affects Harvest. It retains trials, activity manuals, up to 23 profession points per skill, migration and direct profession claiming. Seed refund reaches 30% at level 110. Trials & Manuals supports swipe scrolling and tap-to-claim. Target: Android game 1.6.15.3 with a compatible SMAPI port exposing API 4.3.2+. Physical Android gameplay and Android versions of third-party mods remain unverified.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2Android into Mods and install only one SSE edition. Back up your save and retain config.json when upgrading. New configurations start with AndroidCompatibilityChecksOnly=true; read android-compatibility.json and follow Quick-Start.txt before opting into gameplay on a copied save. Existing Android opt-in settings are retained. Open the journal with its HUD book button. Active abilities require an assigned key or controller button; dedicated ability touch buttons are not included. Farmhand transplant requests are disabled on Android.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Include your edition/version, game and SMAPI versions, platform, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Include android-compatibility.json for Android reports. Generative AI assisted code, translations and page content.[/color][/size][/center]
